title: A Welcome Poster for the Club
instructions: Read the whole passage. Choose ONE answer for each multiple-choice question. For short answers, use words from the passage and follow the word limit.
passage:
On Monday morning, Maya and Leo walk to the English club at their language school. Outside Room 5, Maya can see a woman named Nora. Nora is Leo's neighbor and a doctor. She wants to learn English so she can speak to visitors at work.

In the hallway, Maya points to a white folder on a table. A lamp lights the table. Leo places a yellow notebook on a brown chair. He carries a long ruler and a cup in his bag.

Inside, Ms. Chen welcomes the three people: Maya, Leo, and Nora. It is Nora's first club meeting, and she is a new member. Leo says, "We are on the same team today." Their task is to make a short welcome poster for other students.

During a break, Nora asks, "What is your favorite subject, Leo?" "Math," he says, "but I also enjoy learning English." Maya writes their names on a white card and puts it next to the clock.

At the end of the meeting, Ms. Chen asks the team to choose a time to practice again. Nora is busy on Tuesday because she works at a clinic, but she is free on Wednesday morning. Maya and Leo are free then, too, so they agree to meet here.

Before leaving, Nora stops to say, "Good luck with your class, Maya." Maya thanks her. She likes the club because the members listen to one another.

When they meet again on Wednesday, Ms. Chen places three blue practice cards in a box. Each card has a different opening question. She asks the members to practice with a partner before choosing another card. Nora practices with Maya. Meanwhile, Leo listens and writes down words for the group to review. The members keep the questions short because visitors will have only a few minutes. At the end, Leo puts the cards on a shelf beside the door.

Before leaving, Maya writes a schedule for Wednesday. The first activity is a short conversation with a visitor. Ten minutes of practice will help each member prepare. Maya sends a message with the meeting place and asks everyone to reply by Tuesday. Anyone who cannot attend can choose another time instead of missing the conversation completely.

questions.prompt: Why does Nora want to learn English?

To speak to visitors at work.

questions.explanation: so 后给出学英语的目的，不是为了成为医生或教数学。

questions.explanation: poster 是制作的物品；不要误写摆放姓名的 card。

questions.explanation: Wednesday 是三人都有空的那一天；Tuesday 是 Nora 忙碌的日期。

questions.prompt: How many practice cards does Ms. Chen put in the box?

questions.explanation: 原文说盒子里有三张练习卡。

questions.prompt: What color are the practice cards?
questions.evidence: Ms. Chen places three blue practice cards in a box.
questions.explanation: 新增语境中的练习卡是蓝色。

questions.prompt: What is on each practice card?
questions.evidence: Each card has a different opening question.
questions.explanation: 每张卡有不同的开场问题。

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Chen ask the members to do before choosing another card?
options: Copy every card into one notebook.

questions.prompt: What does Leo do while the others practice?
options: He rearranges the chairs in the hallway.
He prepares a new meal for the group.
He checks whether another room is free.
He listens and notes words to review.
answers: He listens and notes words to review.
questions.evidence: Leo listens and writes down words for the group to review.
questions.explanation: Leo 一边听，一边记录待复习的词。

questions.prompt: Why does the group keep its prompts short?
options: Ms. Chen will print them at home.
The cards are too small to read.
Visitors will have only a few minutes.
The room closes in five minutes.
answers: Visitors will have only a few minutes.
questions.evidence: The members keep the questions short because visitors will have only a few minutes.
questions.explanation: because 后说明来访者的时间有限。

questions.prompt: Where does Leo put the practice cards at the end?
options: On the table next to the clock.
On a shelf beside the door.
In his bag under the chair.
answers: On a shelf beside the door.

questions.explanation: 原文说明结束时放在门边的架子上。
